text:
ria: launching tenant_tags backfill btf-430 on prod-shard-2. requesting lease. tagging @tom for DB watch.

deploybot: Lease granted to operator-2 for job btf-430. configured stall_threshold=90s, lock_alert=enabled. ETA ~10m.

tom: Flip on DB monitors: tail pg_stat_activity and collect blocking_pids. Will page if any lock >4s on user_events/user_tags.

dbadmin: note: schema change last week added index user_tags_idx concurrently, might cause index contention under heavy writes. keep chunk_size small.

ria: starting run with chunk_size=1000, concurrency=3, sleep_between_chunks=200ms. abort_on_lock=true.

deploybot: backfill progress: 15% complete. no alerts yet.

tom: p95 latency creeping to 120ms, p99 spiking to ~600ms, seeing 2 waiters on relation user_events for ~11s.

ops-bot: Observability rule fired: blocking_count>1 for 30s. Flagging for manual review.

dbadmin: Recommend graceful pause. Ill drain one worker to reduce parallelism.

ria: issuing pause: `./backfillctl pause --job btf-430 --grace 20s`.

deploybot: pause acknowledged by workers at 00:06:12. waiting for clean handoff.

tom: still seeing long locks from autovacuum on the new index rebuild, not backfill. autovacuum is aggressive. Suggest temporarily raising `autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit`.

dbadmin: done: increased autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit on shard-2 to reduce impact.

ria: resuming backfill with reduced concurrency=1 and chunk_size=300 per dbadmin suggestion.

deploybot: resume accepted. job btf-430 resumed at 00:09:05.

ria: good catch. monitor for 10 minutes then decide on unpin/unpause windows.

ops-bot: No abort. No pin applied. Monitoring continues.

tom: post-run note: autovacuum and backfill interacted unexpectedly. Proposed long-term: add preflight to coordinate autovacuum windows or schedule backfills to avoid new-index rebuild windows.

ria: drafting release-note: "btf-430 partial pause/resume due to index/autovacuum interaction; no abort. no pin. follow-up: schedule backfills to avoid concurrent index rebuilds." will post after CI upload.

dbadmin: adding runbook entry: heuristics to detect autovacuum-induced long locks + suggested mitigation flags.

ria: closing thread. will open follow-up for scheduling policy. :white_check_mark:
